text:
sanjay: FYI a customer just pinged support asking for SBOM + a firm remediation ETA for a dependency CVE they found in our hosted runtime stack. They flagged "CVE-2026-0456" as their blocker.
maya: can you paste the stack trace / vuln link? I want to see if it's direct or transitive.
sanjay: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-0456
sanjay: support attached this snippet from their scanner:\n```\n/path/to/service/Cargo.lock\n- zstd 1.5.2 (used by fast-compression v0.3.1)\n- CVE-2026-0456: out-of-bounds decompression leading to remote DoS\n- severity: HIGH\n- fixed_in: zstd 1.5.4\n```\nleo: looks transitive via fast-compression -> zstd. We vendor zstd via our shared utils image (runtimes/base:2025-12). Not a direct dependency in app code.
maya: ok. Triage notes: impact on hosted inference: a malicious request could craft payload to trigger OOM/CPU spike on decode path. Risk: moderate-high for public endpoints. No known exploit in wild yet.
maya: proposed immediate actions:
- emergency dependency bump in runtimes/base image to zstd 1.5.4 and rebuild images
- create patch branch for release/1.8.x (Dedicated customers still on 1.8) and backport fix
- Canary deploy to eu-west first, monitor memory/cpu for 24h
- For hosted API, apply request-size rate-limits and decode timeouts as temporary mitigation
- update SBOMs and notify customer with timeline
leo: I can take the container rebuild + image push. ETA 4 hours for build + smoke tests.
ops-bot: deploy job queued: build/runtimes-base@1791234600 -> artifact: runtimes-base:2026-03-?
(Will report status in thread)
nina: I'll own the backport to release/1.8.x and coordinate Dedicated customers. Need approvals for an expedited patch window and to run the full e2e suite on the patch branch.
sanjay: customer asked for a SOC2-friendly remediation statement and proof we tracked the fix (audit evidence). What can we provide besides SBOM and the ETA?
maya: we can provide:
- updated SBOM YAML/CSV for the affected images
- KMS access audit entries showing who rotated any keys (if we rotate during the patch)
- commit hashes and PR link that closes the CVE
- a short mitigation statement mapping to SOC2 control CC7.1 / CC8 (IAP) - i.e., vulnerability management and change control
nina: for evidence, ops-bot can export deployment audit logs and image digests. security-bot can sign off on the CVE closure once CI verifies the zstd version.
security-bot: CVE tracked: CVE-2026-0456. Internal ticket created: SEC-2026-742. Status: investigating. Assign: leo, nina. Severity: High. Mitigation: upgrade zstd to >=1.5.4.
leo: quick note on RBAC: we'll need a temporary service account svc-image-builder with permission to push to prod registry for the emergency build. Requesting ops approval now.
sanjay: we should avoid changing RBAC policies permanently. Ops—please scope the service account to the single registry repo and expire the key in 24h.
ops-bot: RBAC change request submitted: change-id rb-1791234. Expiry TTL: 24h. Awaiting ops approval from @maya and @leo.
maya: approved for the scoped svc-image-builder, ttl 24h. make sure to log the KMS key access when rotating any creds.
leo: starting the build now. I'll post PR link when ready. After build, we run canary in eu-west and us-west in sequence.
sanjay: for the customer reply, draft reply: "We have identified the transitive dependency and are deploying a patch. Expected mitigations: rebuild of runtime images and canary rollout within 6-12 hours; full Dedicated backport within 48 hours. We'll provide updated SBOM and deployment audit logs when done." Anyone want to refine?
nina: add: "Temporary mitigations applied: request size limits and decode timeouts on public endpoints; no evidence of exploitation." Also include ticket SEC-2026-742 and PR link once available.
sanjay: perfect. I'll send that to support to forward to the customer and attach SBOM when ops-bot posts it.
ops-bot: build/runtimes-base started -> job id: 98765. I'll post status and final image digest here.
security-bot: Reminder: after deployment, run the vulnerability scan pipeline (scan-ci) against the new image and attach the report for SOC2 evidence.
leo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/812
change: bump zstd -> 1.5.4, update Cargo.lock, rebuild binaries. CI: green on unit tests, running smoke infra tests.
ops-bot: build succeeded. image: runtimes/base@sha256:abcd1234ef...
SBOM export: sbom/runtimes-base-2026-03-17.csv attached to ticket SEC-2026-742.
security-bot: scan-ci results: zstd 1.5.4 - no known advisories. Full report uploaded to SEC-2026-742.
sanjay: thanks everyone. Nina, pls prepare the customer-facing evidence bundle (SBOM CSV, deployment digest, scan report, ticket id) and paste here once ready.
nina: will do. ETA 2 hours to compose and redact anything sensitive.
sanjay: closing loop: once we have artifacts, we'll mark SEC-2026-742 resolved and notify the customer and SOC2 stakeholder. Great job :thumbsup:
